Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — Redwood trial

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through BrightWare's inference needs. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of key points
- Primary use case: interactive document summarization and customer support routing (~2-3k daily concurrent users during peak).
- Current pain: high latency and cost on existing provider; need predictable SLOs and lower cost per 1k tokens.
- Data sensitivity: PII in transcripts; will need private deployment options and KMS integration on later phases.

Proposed mutual action plan
1) Trial setup (this week): we spin up a dedicated trial environment for BrightWare with a small reserved pool + sample dataset. Action: Marissa to send setup guide and SOW.
2) 2-week POC: validate latency, throughput, and integration with your routing layer. Action: BrightWare to provide sample traffic profile + contact for infra (we discussed Alex Johnson).
3) Decision: production pilot or pause.

Next steps (for this week)
- I attached a short SOW and our trial guide for what the trial will include (BrightWare-Proposed-SOW.pdf, redwood-trial-guide.pdf).
- Can you confirm the technical contact and a preferred start date? We can begin as soon as next Tuesday (May 26).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 15-min sync if useful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
